subject: Supplier activation: CloudVault PO setup + insurance evidence request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Houston <sarah.houston@cloudvault.com>, procurement@cloudvault.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: CloudVault PO setup + insurance evidence request

Hi Sarah / CloudVault procurement team,

Thanks for moving quickly on the integration. We're ready to begin the vendor activation flow on our side; to keep the procurement timeline short can you send the items below by COB next Tuesday (2026-10-13)?

Quick checklist (what Redwood needs to issue a PO and complete onboarding):
- Certificate of Insurance (COI): Commercial General Liability (min $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate), Professional Liability / E&O ($1M), and Cyber Liability ($1M) — insurer name and policy numbers required.
- W-9 (completed and signed) or equivalent tax form for non-US entities.
- Short E&O/Cyber summary page (one-pager with policy limits and retro date).
- Legal company name, physical address for PO, and remit-to invoicing email.
- Point of contact for billing (name + email + phone).
- Signed MSA (we can DocuSign the MSA if you prefer).

Operational notes:
- PO will be issued against the legal entity name you provide; please confirm exactly how it should appear.
- Our standard net-30 terms apply unless otherwise negotiated; if you need different terms flag that up now.

If you can attach the COI and W-9 in your reply that will accelerate the PO creation. I’ve cc'd Ben (procurement lead) and Laura (vendor ops) — Ben will issue the PO once docs arrive. Karthik, flag if we need additional security attestations for CloudVault's offering.

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Sarah Houston <sarah.houston@cloudvault.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: CloudVault PO setup + insurance evidence request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the majority of these items this week. Quick answers inline: 

- COI: will attach copies for General Liability and Cyber by EOD Monday (10/12). Our carrier requires that the insured be listed exactly as "CloudVault Inc." — I'll include policy numbers on the docs.
- E&O: we have a summary sheet (one-pager) and full policy available on request; attaching summary.
- W-9: attached.
- Legal name / remit info: CloudVault Inc.; remit: billing@cloudvault.com; address: 410 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94111.
- Billing POC: Sarah Houston, sarah.houston@cloudvault.com, +1 415-222-3344.

Question: our GL carrier usually lists aggregate limits slightly differently. Is Redwood able to accept $1M per occurrence / $3M aggregate, or do you require $2M aggregate specifically?

We prefer DocuSign for the MSA — please send the envelope and we'll sign.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Finance Ops | CloudVault Inc.

Attachments: CloudVault_COI_GeneralLiability.pdf (stub), CloudVault_EO_Summary.pdf (stub), CloudVault_W9.pdf (stub)

Hi Sarah — welcome, and thanks for the attachments. A couple of quick procurement items before I issue the PO: 

1) Aggregate limit — $3M aggregate is acceptable. We can proceed with the COI as submitted.
2) Please confirm CloudVault's tax ID (EIN) for the PO header.
3) Invoices should be sent to billing@cloudvault.com but also cc accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com so we can route automatically.
4) Preferred PO number placement: include the PO number in the subject line of invoices and on the invoice body.

If you can confirm the EIN in a reply I'll kick off the PO this afternoon and share the PO number.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
